# SiteTrack Pro

> Construction project software for Indian builders, contractors and architects — voice daily progress reports, running account bills, RERA tracking, drawings, labour and client approvals in one workspace.

- [Construction software in Hyderabad](https://www.sitetrackpro.in/construction-software-hyderabad): For builders in Hyderabad and Telangana.

## Key facts

- SiteTrack Pro is a construction project management platform for the Indian construction market.
- Field staff dictate daily progress reports in Telugu, Hindi or English; geotagged photos are captured with the report.
- Reports, photos and attendance queue offline and sync automatically on poor-signal sites.
- Finance covers budgets vs actuals, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices and Running Account (RA) bills with GST percent, TDS and net receivable.
- RERA stage tracking and statutory approvals/NOC registers support compliance for Telangana and other Indian states.
- DXF drawings preview inline; two revisions can be diffed as an overlay.
- Client approvals, revision links (password/OTP-gated, expiring) and a client portal are built in.
- Pricing is per organization, not per seat, from ₹5,999/month (exclusive of 18% GST). Annual billing saves ~17%.
- Every organization is isolated at the database row level with role-based permissions and an immutable audit trail.
- The product is available in English, Telugu and Hindi.
